title: From Safari to Zanzibar: How the Transfer Works
excerpt: Most travellers fly from the safari area to Zanzibar. How the transfer works, luggage limits and timing.
body:
The journey from safari to beach is usually done by domestic flight.

## Where from

- **Arusha Airport** or **Kilimanjaro Airport**, after your safari.
- Directly from **Serengeti airstrips** or **Lake Manyara**, saving a drive.

## Flight time

About one to two hours, sometimes with a stop.

## Luggage

Domestic airlines usually have limits of around 15–20 kg in soft bags. See [luggage limits on safari flights](/blog/domestic-flights-luggage/).

## Timing

Morning flights let you enjoy your first afternoon on the beach. Allow time for a transfer from the airport to your hotel: up to an hour or more to the east or north coast.

## Organisation

We arrange flights and transfers as part of your trip, so connections work.

[Plan your safari and beach trip](/travel-proposal/).
